Yes. The evidence identifies a **13.5 ha tree-cover loss candidate in 2025**, equivalent to 3.91% of the property. The 2020 JRC forest reference agrees with 98% of the candidate area.

The finding is **pending corroboration** because 2025 is the latest observed year; a later observation is needed to assess persistence. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change, its cause, or whether it was legal.
